name: Everglow
source:
Experience story of Glow, young and naive furry heroine caught between two empires interplanetary ambitions forged in tragedy and conspiracy.

10 years ago, an incident occurred that sowed discord between the empires of Wolves and Foxes. But it does not matter to Glow, an ordinary, unremarkable employee of the research institute. Her days are devoted to shuffling papers around at work and talking with her beloved cactus at home. But all of this will change soon...
translation:
体验兽人女主角Glow的故事。她年轻而天真，被卷入两大帝国的星际野心之中，而这场野心由悲剧与阴谋铸成。

10年前，一起事件在狼族帝国与狐族帝国之间埋下了不和的种子。但对Glow来说，这些都无关紧要。她只是研究所里一名普通得不能再普通的职员，每天上班整理文件，回家后和心爱的仙人掌聊天。然而，这一切很快就会改变……
